[[File:Exploding_asteroid.jpg|thumb|300px|The exploded asteroid]]
Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] exploded, spewing large amounts of molten rock into space.<ref name="SWG">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The exploding asteroid can be seen in the Kashyyyk system in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion to [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. It is a two-dimensional animated background image. The game provides no further information about the object or the events leading to its explosion. In the game files the animation is called "exploding asteroid".<ref name="SWG" />
